page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmgn7ix.32xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server instance built on the x86_64 architecture using KVM virtualization. The instance features 128 dedicated vCPUs powered by Intel Xeon 8369B processors operating at a clock speed of 2.9 GHz. System memory totals 512 GB of RAM, providing a allocation density of 4 GB of RAM per core.

Hardware acceleration is supplied by eight integrated NVIDIA A10 GPUs, providing a combined VRAM capacity of 192 GB, with each accelerator equipped with 24 GB of VRAM. High-speed data exchange across cluster nodes is enabled by a 160 Gbps baseline network bandwidth capacity. The server configuration does not include local disk storage volumes, and zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned by default.

From a cost efficiency perspective, the provision of eight NVIDIA A10 accelerators combined with 128 dedicated vCPUs optimizes computational and graphical processing density without incurring local storage hardware overhead. The primary hardware tradeoff is the reliance on external network storage for all persistent disk requirements. This hardware profile is suited for artificial intelligence inference, parallel graphics rendering, video processing pipelines, and computer vision workloads.
